item.description:
New feature: Synced Folder. Pick a folder on your Mac and everything you add or change in it uploads to your B2 bucket on its own, no need to drag anything into the Explorer.
You can choose where it lands inside the bucket, and decide whether deleting a file locally also deletes it in B2 (off by default). If you rename or delete the folder by accident, the app lets you know.
History now has its own view summarizing this sync: first activation, files uploaded, average speed, and total uploaded.
Also: toggles instead of checkboxes, a more compact window, and several translation fixes.

BackBlaze2Sync 1.2
New visual section in Statistics: a chart showing uploads by file type (with hover effects for each), and a graph of MB uploaded per day (last 14 days, with hover details showing date and size). More detailed file categories: Video, Audio, and Compressed categories added. Color adjustments: a more vibrant custom palette.

Menu bar overhaul: Preferences (⌘,), quick access to New Connection/History/Stats/Gallery, New Tab, Move/Copy selection in Edit.
New About panel with credits + GitHub link.
Real auto-updates via Sparkle (Check for Updates…).
Help menu: Report an Issue (GitHub) and Send Feedback (email).
New Stats window: bucket size, oldest/largest file, file types, estimated B2 cost, upload activity.
